description: The merge mints a flow for a source row it cannot place on an existing one. Where several rows mean the same catch-all substance, each mints a private copy, and the published list ends up holding twenty flows with one name in one context -- one carrying the characterisation factors and nineteen empty. A consumer picking any of the nineteen scores the emission as zero. See #60.

expectations.title: `Herbicides, Unspecified` is published once per context, not twenty times
expectations.comment: 20 active flows in this context in the 2026-08-14 build, of which one carries a factor and nineteen carry none. Six other contexts hold the same twenty. The copies come from ecoinvent 3.12's manual-addition rows: Beflubutamid, Bicyclopyrone, Cafenstrole, Chlorimuron and 31 more each mint their own rather than joining the flow that is already there. Met on the build of 1 September 2026, and the pending flag was dropped with that recording.

expectations.title: The merge mints no flow that collides with one already in the list
expectations.comment: 193 in the 2026-08-14 build, across 29 collision groups, and every one of the 193 carries no characterisation factor. The check that counts them runs after the merge, which is what #60 asked for and got; what it reports is that the duplication was never stopped. Held as a measure rather than as a claim about one flow because the population is what has to reach zero. Met on the build of 1 September 2026, and the pending flag was dropped with that recording.
